blindness_attestations.context_limitation: The task supplied candidate cohort role and the allowed class list. The neutral manifest exposed source dataset, asset IDs and hashes but no class labels. No source URLs were opened. Visible text within photographs was available as pixels.
blindness_attestations.cohort_scope: All 253 frozen candidates reviewed: P001-P109 and O001-O144. Initial P001-P050 hashes matched their final neutral manifest and labels were retained. All 109 positive-batch rows were retained unchanged for this final audit.
blindness_attestations.ood_retrieval_group_context: Frozen retrieval group names were visible before image review and were not treated as ground truth. Visual content determined assignments; confirmed true OOD rows then received the supplied row-key group.
blindness_attestations.source_group_hash_fields: The supplied map was clarified to distinguish collector and neutral manifest hashes. The re-read neutral_manifest_sha256 matches the bound OOD neutral manifest. Group assignments did not change.
